entities.name: Vinçens Prennushi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vinçenc Prennushi was an Albanian Roman Catholic professed member from the Order of Friars Minor and he served as the Archbishop of Durrës from 1940 until his death. Prennushi became a noted poet and writer and published several works on national and international matters.
